text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a fantastic demonstration of<n>power and speed
on a G1 stage,<n>Mejiro Dober feels more confident
about taking on the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Oka Sho, the first race<n>of the Triple
Tiara. Mejiro Dober's<n>classic-year battle is about
to begin!
